spec: Return the sum of two 64-bit signed integers a and b.
reference_c: int64_t add_i64(int64_t a, int64_t b) { return a + b; }

spec: Return the maximum of three 64-bit signed integers a, b, and c.
signature: int64_t max3_i64(int64_t a, int64_t b, int64_t c)

spec: Return the absolute value of a 64-bit signed integer. x is never INT64_MIN.
reference_c: int64_t abs_i64(int64_t x) { return x < 0 ? -x : x; }

spec: Clamp x into the closed interval [lo, hi]. Assume lo <= hi.
signature: int64_t clamp_i64(int64_t x, int64_t lo, int64_t hi)

spec: Return the sum of integers from 1 to n inclusive. If n < 1, return 0.
Return 1 if n is a prime number, else 0. n is a small non-negative integer.
Return the greatest common divisor of two non-negative 64-bit integers using Euclid's algorithm. gcd(0, 0) is 0.
Return n! for n in 0..12 inclusive. For n < 0 return 1.
Return the n-th Fibonacci number with fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1, iteratively. n is in 0..30.
Return the sum of n 32-bit signed integers in arr, as a 64-bit integer. If n <= 0, return 0.
Return the maximum of n 32-bit signed integers in arr. If n <= 0, return 0.
Return the dot product of two length-n arrays of 32-bit signed integers, as a 64-bit integer. If n <= 0, return 0.
signature: int64_t dot_i32(const int32_t *a, const int32_t *b, int64_t n)

spec: Reverse n 32-bit signed integers in arr in place. If n <= 1, do nothing.
Return how many of the n 32-bit signed integers in arr are equal to v. If n <= 0, return 0.
signature: int64_t count_eq_i32(const int32_t *arr, int64_t n, int32_t v)

spec: Copy n bytes from src to dest. dest and src do not overlap. If n <= 0, do nothing.
signature: void memcpy_u8(uint8_t *dest, const uint8_t *src, int64_t n)

spec: Return the length of the NUL-terminated byte string s, not counting the terminator.
Compare two NUL-terminated byte strings. Return a negative int if a<b, zero if equal, positive if a>b (memcmp order on unsigned bytes).
Return how many times unsigned byte c occurs in the NUL-terminated string s (the terminator is not counted).
Return the sum of two IEEE-754 doubles a and b.
reference_c: double add_f64(double a, double b) { return a + b; }

spec: Return the dot product of two length-n arrays of doubles. If n <= 0, return 0.0. Inputs are chosen so the result is exact in IEEE-754.
signature: double dot_f64(const double *a, const double *b, int64_t n)
